title: Add website header art for img-gen and mac-screenshot.
paragraphs: Generated 1376x768 banners under each tool docs folder, wire headers in website/src/tools.ts, fix mac-screenshot card icon to a local Silk monitor asset, refresh root README thumbnails.

title: Use a native macOS overlay for voice-type and move its hotkey to F12.
paragraphs: This fixes the focus loss caused by the Tk overlay on macOS, keeps text input selected while recording, and frees up F12 by moving mac-screenshot to F11.

title: Add macOS screenshot hotkey tool.
paragraphs: I added a new macOS screenshot daemon that listens for F12, saves selection captures with sensible naming, copies them to the clipboard, and opens them in Preview so the flow is quick to use day to day.
